0xb9812e2fa995ec53b5b6df34d21f9304762c54.desc: DutchX exchange proxy (dx_2). Three claim layers — L1 direct WETH/SAI balances (withdraw only), L2 unclaimed auction positions (claimBuyerFunds/claimSellerFunds + withdraw), L3 partially-claimed positions (same two-step flow). Positions use compressed fields: t=type(buyer/seller), st=sellToken, bt=buyToken, ai=auctionIndex, w=claimable_weth. Unattributable gap: ~6.3 ETH.

0xaf1745c0f8117384dfa5fff40f824057c70f2e.name: DutchX dx_3
0xaf1745c0f8117384dfa5fff40f824057c70f2e.desc: DutchX exchange proxy (dx_3). WETH and SAI only. Three claim layers — L1 direct WETH/SAI balances (withdraw only), L2/L3 unclaimed auction positions (claimBuyerFunds/claimSellerFunds + withdraw). Positions carry received_token/received_symbol — check the field, do not assume WETH. sai_balance = total claimable SAI (direct + positions); sai_direct = direct L1 SAI only. Unattributable gap: ~23 WETH / ~2,439 SAI.

0x0286f920F893513C7ec9FE35ba0A4760229a24.name: SingularX Fund
0x0286f920F893513C7ec9FE35ba0A4760229a24.desc: SingularX was a decentralized exchange launched in 2017 on ConsenSys's Tokit platform. Its SingularDTVFund contract distributed ETH trading-fee rewards pro-rata to SNGX token holders, who claim their share by calling withdrawReward(). The exchange and its UI are long defunct, but the reward pool still holds ETH and the claim path remains permissionless.

0x1E0447b19BB6EcFdAe1e4AE1694b0C3659614e.name: dYdX Solo Margin
0x1E0447b19BB6EcFdAe1e4AE1694b0C3659614e.desc: dYdX's original Solo Margin lending and margin-trading contract. The v1/v2 web app was retired when dYdX moved to StarkEx and then to its own chain, but Solo itself was never wound down: it still holds the WETH, USDC and DAI its suppliers deposited, and every balance remains withdrawable by its owner. Positions are held in numbered sub-accounts rather than against a plain address, so a single wallet may have several separate balances to claim.

0x090D4613473dEE047c3f2706764f49E0821D25.name: Uniswap UNI Airdrop
0x090D4613473dEE047c3f2706764f49E0821D25.desc: The September 2020 UNI genesis distribution. Every address that used Uniswap before that month was allocated UNI through a merkle distributor, but claiming needs a merkle proof and the interface that served those proofs is long gone. The contract never expired and was never swept, so the remaining allocations are still claimable.

0x5b67871c3a857de81a1ca0f9f7945e5670d986.name: Set Protocol (TokenSets)
0x5b67871c3a857de81a1ca0f9f7945e5670d986.desc: Set Protocol powered TokenSets, an automated portfolio product from 2019-2021 where each strategy was an ERC-20 token backed by real collateral held in a shared vault. The TokenSets front end is gone, but the vault still holds the collateral and redemption is still open: burning a Set token returns its underlying share, unwrapped straight back to ETH.
